text: Hundru Falls is a waterfall located in Ranchi District in the Indian state of Jharkhand. It is the 34th highest waterfall in India, and one of the most famous tourist places in the region.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
